issues: Broken: every .reveal element was opacity:0 until an IntersectionObserver fired, so on the homepage the menu board, stats, story, gallery, quote and CTA rendered as ~2000px of empty black (desktop, mobile and stress). The signature dotted-leader menu board was not visible on the homepage at all
Catalog: CTA section invisible for the same reason, leaving a huge dead gap between the menu board and the footer

Today's special plate: .plate__img and .plate__body are inline spans, so aspect-ratio was ignored. With no image the dish placeholder collapsed to a tiny 'FM' and the burst badge covered the product name
Brand robustness: muted brand colours (Brinks brown, Fredimare ochre) came out as beige/cream tubes, so the 'neon' read as dull white text instead of gas-lit glass
Category records grid left-aligned a lone record (Brinks has 1 category) with a big empty cream field on the right; 6 records gave a ragged 4+2 row
Menu board title 'MENU.' was plain slab text, which missed the chance to repeat the neon motif on the signature board

Good stuff: the hero neon sign with hanging wires, the checker floor in perspective, the record-sleeve categories, the awning and the chrome-framed board are genuinely characterful (creativity 7, typography 7, layout 5 because of the voids, polish 3, brand robustness 5, mobile 5, generic-ness: low)
fixed: Reveal system rebuilt so content is never hidden by default. The entrance is a keyframe animation (fill: backwards) that only plays once .in is added, so no-JS, no-scroll and screenshot renders show every section. Dotted leaders now draw in with the same pattern, staggered per row
Plate image/body set to display:block, so the Today's special card gets its square photo or striped dish placeholder again and the burst sits on the image, not the title
Neon colours derived with a chroma floor (oklch max(c,.13)), so brown or grey brands still produce a saturated glowing tube in their own hue
Category records switched to a centred flex layout: one record shows large and centred, two or three share the row in thirds, four or more go in quarters, and mobile uses two columns
Menu board title is now a Monoton neon tube in the brand colour that flicks on when the board enters the viewport, tying the signature board to the hero sign
IntersectionObserver thresholds relaxed so tall boards on mobile still trigger the leader animation
